## createApp() function

Create just the Hono app without server lifecycle.

Useful for testing or custom server setups.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createApp(manifests: AppManifest[], options?: Pick<ServerOptions, 'cors' | 'logging' | 'prettyJson'>): Hono<{
    Variables: AuthVariables;
```
